latest_release.name: v2.17.0
latest_release.body: The dark mode interface has changed colour due to the Tabler theme updates > [!WARNING] > Certbot has been updated. Exercise caution with this upgrade as your DNS plugins may not work as expected and require tweaks to dependencies. See the [Certbot Doc](https://nginxproxymanager.com/certbot/) for more info. > > EdgeDNS, Beget and Infomaniak DNS plugins have breaking changes. Consider creating new DNS SSL Certificates using these providers and remove the old ones. ## Changes - Add certbot plugin for Scaleway DNS (thanks @seaeagle1) - Added ip-projects certbot definitions (thanks @capitain-schos) - Update Hetzner certbot plugin to v4.0.0 (thanks @lsr0) - Update infomaniak certbot plugin to 0.3.3 (thanks @Alexis-Loskoutoff) - Changed target plugin for Beget (thanks @l1n-x) - Update package name and version for Baidu DNS plugin (thanks @chenghaopeng) - Update dns-multi plugin version to 5.6.0 (thanks @wikrie) - Update Akamai Edge DNS plugin and credentials for v0.3.0 (thanks @jeezat) - fix: only chown /data/keys.json if necessary (thanks @xJayMorex) - fix: omit certificate_key from certificate API responses (thanks @Amitind) - Don't start IP ranges renewal timer when fetching is disabled (thanks @PrassanthVG) - Fix access list rules and SSL missing from re-rendered host configs - Require authentication to validate certificates (thanks @Alexis-Loskoutoff) - Remove a certificate's certbot files on delete even when revoking fails (thanks @mikeyhenein) - Show certbot's failure reason in the UI instead of "Internal Error" (thanks @mikeyhenein) - Reject unknown keys in PUT /api/users/:id/permissions (an extra key crashes the backend) (thanks @mikeyhenein) - Backend: refresh yarn.lock within the declared ranges (fixes 15 of 16 advisories, incl. body-parser DoS) (thanks @mikeyhenein) - s6-overlay 3.2.3.2 (thanks @mikeyhenein) - Frontend tests: disable Node's built-in localStorage so vitest works on Node 25+ (thanks @mikeyhenein) - Frontend: refresh dependencies (thanks @mikeyhenein) - Show certificate details in host tables (thanks @SebZar) - Rremove stale nginx pid file before starting nginx (thanks @Rip-07) - Prevent data loss when dismissing unsaved forms (thanks @mirfalltnixein) - Skip propagation seconds option for Route 53 DNS challenge (thanks @junkerderprovinz) - Apply the HSTS sub-domains setting per host (thanks @Juice-de-Orange) - Fix nginx reload after certificate renewal (thanks @Waterman1997) - Preserve hostname keys in HTTP certificate test results (thanks @hafizahmedzia) - Preserve client ports in forwarded Host headers (thanks @lennondotw) - Update Korean translation (thanks @StopDragon) - Rate limit auth endpoints and scope user proxy host permissions (thanks @auzcoder) - Fix authentication oracle (thanks @Alexis-Loskoutoff) - Updated Add missing German (de) and Italian (it) translations (thanks @Juice-de-Orange) - 🇹🇼 Add Traditional Chinese (Taiwan) translation (thanks @occultsound) - 🇻🇳 Updated Vietnamese locale (thanks @nglinh28) - 🇳🇱 Updated Netherlands locale (thanks @Stephan-P) - 🇫🇷 Updated french translations (thanks @Alexis-Loskoutoff) ## Docker images -
